reason: Process is qualitative fundamental analysis with management meetings, DCF valuations and 3-5 year holds; no concrete quantitative rules for daily-bar testing.

universe.description: ASX stocks with high ROIC, high and growing margins, founder-led businesses

setup.rule: Screen for ROIC >15%, ROE >15%, EBIT margin >20% and growing
setup.quote: I like to screen for a company with uh return on equity above 15%, return on invested capital above 15%, a EBIT margin above 20%, EBIT margin that's growing say at least 10% peranom

entry.rule: Meet management and obtain third-party verification before investing
entry.quote: the next step is to meet management is the main criteria. We need to meet management. We need some third party verification.

exits.rule: Sell when valuation stretched or better opportunities appear
exits.quote: the last step in the in the process is that selling selling discipline really which is just all about the valuation

sizing.quote: we've got a fairly high conviction portfolios between 30 stocks and and the hedge portfolio is is 20 stocks

ambiguities.issue: Transcript covers ASX not US stocks
ambiguities.assumption: Rules do not transfer to US daily-bar testing
